title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Program Schedule: Program Fees, Invoicing and Rent Volume Discount
content:
**Bluegate Business Storage Account — program schedule, invoicing facet.** Each program of the Bluegate Business Storage Account carries its own monthly program fee, its own invoice delivery channel, its own invoicing options and its own rent volume discount. The figures below apply per program and are the figures the monthly account invoice uses.

## Schedule

| Program | Monthly program fee | Consolidated invoicing of unit and parking rents | Agreements at several facilities on one account | Invoice delivery | Purchase-order number printed on invoices | Sales-tax exemption certificate can be applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | $0.00 | Yes | No | Email | No | No |
| Bluegate Business Plus | $19.00 | Yes | No | Email | No | Yes |
| Bluegate Business Pro | $39.00 | Yes | No | Email | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | $79.00 | Yes | Yes | Email and online portal | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | $59.00 | Yes | Yes | Email and online portal | Yes | Yes |
| Bluegate Business National Account | $149.00 | Yes | Yes | EDI and online portal | Yes | Yes |

## Rent volume discount

The rent volume discount is a percentage taken off the monthly rent of each business-billed agreement. It applies while the business holds at least the number of active agreements shown for its program.

| Program | Discount on the monthly rent of each business-billed agreement | Active agreements needed for the discount |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 0% (no reduction) | 0 |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 0% (no reduction) | 0 |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 3% | 3 |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 5% | 3 |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 5% | 5 |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 8% | 10 |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- The monthly program fee is a fixed dollar amount per month for the account as a whole; it does not vary with the number of agreements.
- Consolidated invoicing is offered on every program, so every program presents the business's unit and parking rents on its one monthly account invoice.
- Only Bluegate Business Logistics, Bluegate Business Fleet and Bluegate Business National Account allow agreements at several facilities to be billed on one account.
- For Bluegate Business Essentials and Bluegate Business Plus the discount percentage is 0%, so the rent volume discount never reduces a rent on those programs, whatever the agreement count.
- Bluegate Business Logistics and Bluegate Business Fleet share the same 5% discount but need different agreement counts: 3 on Logistics, 5 on Fleet.

## Reading the schedule — hypothetical illustrations

*Hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*

- A business on Bluegate Business Pro holds 3 active agreements. The count meets the 3 needed, so each business-billed agreement's monthly rent is reduced by 3%. A rent of $200.00 a month is reduced by $6.00, to $194.00.
- The same business on Bluegate Business Fleet with the same 3 active agreements falls short of the 5 needed on Fleet, so no rent volume discount applies to its rents.
- A business on Bluegate Business National Account holding 10 active agreements meets the 10 needed; a rent of $150.00 is reduced by 8%, that is by $12.00, to $138.00.
